title.en: An Act to Provide that the Office of Provincial Governor of the Province of Mindoro Shall Be Elective, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
It is hereby provided that the office of provincial governor of the Province of Mindoro shall be
elective.e His qualifications, the qualifications of the electors, the date of the election, the form and manner in
which the same shall be effected, the term of office, and the manner of filling the same in case of absence,
illness, or vacancy, shall be governed by the provisions of the Election Law, as amended by subsequent
legislation. His duties and powers shall be those prescribed by Act Numbered Thirteen hundred and ninety-six
and its amendments.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 3, 1916.
